text:
sasha: Quick heads-up — prism11b (int4) bring-up is hitting sporadic OOMs and memory fragmentation when batch_size >= 4. P50 latency also doubled on some workloads.
lin: Can you paste a repro and the logs?
sasha: Repro is mixed-length prompts (8–1024 tokens) with default max_new_tokens=512. Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-22T14:12:34Z] ERROR OOM allocating 1.2GB for kv_cache_alloc
slab: free_chunks: many small fragments, total_free=3.4GB but largest_contiguous=200MB
stack: inference.h:kv.cc:142 allocate_kv_cache
```
sasha: Current canary cfg snippet:
```yaml
model: prism11b
quant: int4
batching:
  batch_size: 4
  max_new_tokens: 512
  prefetch: true
kv:
  trim: false
  compaction: disabled
```
maya: That kv.trim: false + aggressive prefetch is the smell. For int4 we should be conservative: enable kv_trim (0.65–0.8), reduce prefetch window, and lower batch soft-limit. Also try batch pacing cwnd from 2 -> 1 to avoid coalescing lots of mid-length requests. Warmup with small sequences reduces slab churn.
raj: Also change the canary default max_new_tokens to 256 (instead of 512). Int4 quant + long decode = higher transient allocation. Add a soft-evict threshold at 0.85 so we start trimming before hard OOM.
omar: Proposed canary rollout policy:
- slot_reserve: 0.15
- slow_start: 30s (ramp traffic over 2 min)
- batch_soft_limit: 3
- fallback: model variant int8 if OOM spike > 3 in 5m
Sensible?
sasha: Yup. I'll open the config PR and attach a perf checklist. Who can run a 50k-token mixed-length bench?
lin: I can run the bench. Which harness?
sasha: Use infra/bench/v2 token distro: `infra/bench/v2/token-dist.yaml` and run:
```
./bench --model prism11b --quant int4 --workers 4 --duration 10m --mix-file infra/bench/v2/token-dist.yaml
```
Please capture slab/free-list stats and per-request kv occupancy.
devops-bot: Deploy started: canary-prism11b-int4 -> prism-canary-42 by sasha
maya: Also schedule a KV compaction job 1m before warmup: `./kvcompact --model prism11b --target=0.6` — compaction reduces fragmentation spikes on warmup.
raj: Add regression evals: latency suite + quality suite. Ensure quantization quality delta < 1.5% on our core NLU evals, otherwise abort rollout.
omar: Note to ops — set an automatic fallback to prism11b-int8 if OOM_count > 3 within 5 minutes. Also capture heap diffs for the first 10k tokens of the run.
sasha: Timeline: open PR (config + checklist) by EOD, bench run tomorrow 09:00 PT, canary rollout noon if bench looks stable.
maya: Tagging #eng-oncall so alerts are routed during rollout.
devops-bot: Subscribed #eng-oncall to canary-prism11b-int4 alerts
lin: For logs, capture: slab free list stats, kv occupancy histogram, per-request tokens, and allocator fragmentation metric. `metrics.slab.free_percent` + `kv.occupancy.p95` are most useful.
sasha: Adding those to PR checklist + runbook (how to revert + fallback).
maya: Ack :thumbsup:
